Bill.BriefDescription: Assisting self-employed small business owners adversely impacted by health insurance premium changes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assisting self-employed small business ownersadversely impacted by health insurance premium changes; adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW; creating a new section; and providing anexpiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The federal affordable care act creatednumerous changes to health insurance products. Some small groups thatpurchased health insurance in 2013 have been adversely impacted by theincrease in the premiums for the new insurance plans that meet all therequirements of the federal affordable care act. It is the intent ofthe legislature to provide some assistance to those selfemployed smallbusiness owners, often known as groups of one, that have been adverselyimpacted by the premium increases with a transitional business andoccupations tax credit.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax under this section, a credit is allowed p. 1 SB 6233for a qualifying purchase of small group health insurance by a selfemployed business owner. (2) The credit may only be taken for qualifying purchases of smallgroup health insurance made between January 1, 2014, and December 31,2014. (3) Prior to claiming the credit the department must approve of thequalifying purchase of health insurance, and the department maycoordinate with the office of the insurance commissioner forverification of the premium rates and available products, and may writerules to administer this program. (4) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Qualifying purchase of small group health insurance" means anew insurance plan that was purchased by a selfemployed business owneras a result of the federal affordable care act that was twentyfivepercent over the previous health insurance premiums paid by thebusiness owner and that no other health insurance policies wereavailable with a less than twentyfive percent increase. Thequalifying purchase credit amount is the amount of the differencebetween the previous health insurance premium payments and the newhealth insurance premium payments. (b) "Selfemployed business owner" means a selfemployed individualor sole proprietor as defined in RCW 48.43.005.
